alignment_reasoning: The image clearly depicts a sorrel/chestnut horse head. The fine_grained_classifier confirmed the class with high confidence. It is a valid partial view but lacks complete class feature verification.

The animal_pose_auditor flagged high uncertainty in the facial and limb keypoints, which, while partially attributable to AI domain shift, correlates with the visible softness/blur in the face.
